definitions: To have a grievance or complaint to discuss with someone.
To have an issue to resolve or confront someone about.
examples: I have a bone to pick with you about that comment.
She had a bone to pick with her brother over the borrowed car.
The manager had a bone to pick with the team regarding their performance.
lemma: to have a bone to pick
synonyms: to have a score to settle
to have an axe to grind
source: to have a bone to pick
